description: Treatment of patients with relapsed/refractory low grade B cell Non Hodgkin's lymphoma (NHL).

contributions.description: HSE approval date set to the version 3 date (2022-06-27). This indication is narrower, for stage 3/4 follicular lymphoma instead of low grade B cell NHL in version 1 (https://web.archive.org/web/20170414161421/http://www.hse.ie/eng/services/list/5/cancer/profinfo/chemoprotocols/Lymphoma_Myeloma/293.pdf) and version 2 (https://web.archive.org/web/20190718155234/https://www.hse.ie/eng/services/list/5/cancer/profinfo/chemoprotocols/lymphoma-myeloma/293.pdf) of the treatment regimen. The current indication first appears in version 3 (https://web.archive.org/web/20230924113110/https://www.hse.ie/eng/services/list/5/cancer/profinfo/chemoprotocols/lymphoma-myeloma/r%20cvp%20v3%20293.pdf).
